name: The kernel refutes lead 90c4f258: the two instants the lead prints are 50541 s = 14 h 02 m 21 s apart, not the seventeen hours (61200 s) it concludes — that figure appears only if the offset the lead itself printed is dropped. This decides the lead's arithmetic and NOTHING else: whether production tracked main, and whether the deployment listing was misread, are not settled here and no kernel settles them.
